instruction: I need to increase my bash history size to save more commands. Look up how to configure HISTSIZE and HISTFILESIZE in bash and set them to larger values in my .bashrc file.

command: import pyautogui; import time; time.sleep(0.5); pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5); pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 'alt', 't'); time.sleep(0.5)
